title: Desaturation and chemical recovery from desalination concentrates using ion exchange and bipolar membrane electrodialysis as a zero liquid discharge process
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00977D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Luis Salas, Alex Schwarz, Alvaro Gonzalez-Vogel
An electrodialysis-based desaturation system offers a sustainable alternative to evaporation for zero liquid discharge in pulp mills, recovering 0.67 M NaOH with 73% efficiency while reducing costs from 0.43 to 0.20 USD per m3.
